mapper.sql: select a.id, a.material_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_rule_putaway a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.material_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, b.code as materialCode, b.name as materialName from t_rule_putaway a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.material_id = #{materialId} and a.status = #{status} and b.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and b.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%')
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_rule_putaway set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_rule_putaway set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, a.material_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, b.code as materialCode, b.name as materialName from t_rule_putaway a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}

select a.material_id , b.location_id, ifnull(tl.pallet_num, tt.location_id+'') as inStockStatus from t_rule_putaway a inner join t_rule_putaway_detail b on a.id = b.rule_putaway_id left join t_location tl on b.location_id = tl.id left join t_tray tt on tl.pallet_num = tt.code where a.del_flag = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '1' and a.material_id in
#{materialId}
